trends.label: AI-native banking PM demand up
trends.detail: UK and Singapore fintechs are prioritising PMs who can work alongside LLM pipelines, not just manage roadmaps. Candidates with shipped AI products (even personal ones) are advancing further in rounds.

trends.label: Core banking migration roles proliferating
trends.detail: Legacy-to-cloud core banking migrations are accelerating across European and APAC banks. PMs with direct migration ownership — not just adjacent programme management — are in short supply.

trends.label: Regulated fintech overtaking pure tech PM hiring
trends.detail: Post-2024 macro environment has shifted hiring toward fintechs operating under banking licences. Change governance and compliance experience is now a differentiator, not a liability.

news.headline: UK Skilled Worker visa salary threshold raised
news.summary: The minimum salary for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship in the UK was raised to £38,700 in 2024. Senior PM roles typically clear this threshold comfortably, making the route accessible for Indian candidates with 7+ years experience.

news.headline: Singapore MAS fast-tracking fintech talent visas
news.summary: MAS expanded the Tech.Pass and Employment Pass schemes for senior fintech professionals, with processing times now under 3 weeks for applicants with demonstrable product track records.

news.headline: Australia PR pathway eased for fintech PMs
news.summary: Senior Product Manager is on Australia's Skills in Demand list, enabling employer-sponsored 482 visas with a direct pathway to permanent residence for Indian nationals with relevant banking experience.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
certifications.why: Cloud-native architecture language is expected in core banking migration roles in UK and German banks — this cert signals you speak the same language as the engineering team.

certifications.name: SAFe 6 Product Owner / Product Manager
certifications.why: SAFe certification is explicitly listed in a large proportion of senior PM JDs at UK and Australian banks. Takes 2 days and directly addresses the 'scaled agile' requirement many JDs carry.

certifications.name: PMP (Project Management Professional)
certifications.why: PMP is visa-adjacent: immigration points-based systems in Australia and Canada award points for internationally recognised professional certifications.

visaIntel.trend: Skilled Worker visa is the primary route. Senior PM roles at banks and fintechs typically clear the £38,700 salary threshold. Companies with Sponsor Licences are searchable on the UK Home Office register.

Employment Pass (EP) is accessible for senior product professionals with 7+ years. MAS-regulated fintechs and regional HQ banks are the most active sponsors. Tech.Pass is an alternative for independent builders.

EU Blue Card is the primary route — requires a recognised degree and a salary above ~€58k. German is not required for most tech PM roles at international companies. Berlin and Munich are the strongest markets.

Employer-Sponsored 482 visa (Skills in Demand) is the entry route. Senior PM is on the skills list. PR pathway is a clear 2-year trajectory for most sponsored hires. Sydney and Melbourne are the main hiring hubs.

H-1B is a lottery — low odds for 2025/26 cycle. L-1 (intracompany transfer) or O-1A (extraordinary ability) are more reliable routes for senior candidates. Large banks and established fintechs are more reliable sponsors.
